doc_name: Fencing at the 1964 Summer Olympics – Women's team foil
text: The women's team foil was one of eight fencing events featured in the fencing programme at the 1964 Summer Olympics and marked its second appearance as an event. The competition took place from October 16 to October 17, 1964. A total of 47 fencers from 10 nations participated. In the event, ties between teams were resolved first by individual victories (as noted in parentheses), and then by the number of touches received.
